amendment.reason: Pyro's post-sampling cumulative minimum allocates quadratic storage in the number of lags. Replace it with an equivalent linear-storage calculation for finite diagnostic arrays. Retain every diagnostic, sampler setting, starting point, seed, target and prior.
amendment.authorization_scope: One fresh high-resolution attempt under the unchanged two-hour and 2 GiB per-fit limits. Include the failed attempt's time and peak memory in the cost record and the twelve-hour study budget. No recovery or predictive scores have been examined.

decision: Obtain the declared high-resolution four-chain posterior with bounded-memory diagnostics. This refinement changes diagnostic storage only; accepted six-bin inference is retained.
